entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-09-19
entry.content:
Issues

Closed

  • [EnC] `Unexpected null - file EditSession.cs` when updating the body of a method in a nested class when marked with `CreateNewOnMetadataUpdate` #76989
  • IDE0008 (Use explicit type) Fix All operation is too broad #38953
    Backlog
  • Failing tests in upgrade to VS 17.14p1 #77293
    18.0
  • Consider not emitting CS1998 for interface implementations / method overrides #77001
    Next
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-11018.126 #80371
  • Unexpected error is reported when an added module contains an extension block #80294
    Next

Updated

  • CA1859 incorrectly being raised on a public property #80375
  • Six compiler tests are failing locally when targeting `net472` #80353
    Next
  • Collection expressions are suggested for types where it doesn't make sense, and their error messages show inconsistent types #73655
    Backlog

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix add missing using from throwing exceptions in serialization #80381
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Update configs for 18.0.P2 snap #80380
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Propagate CompilerLoweringPreserve marked attributes in more scenarios involving async local functions. #80379
    Area-Compilers
  • Fix a replay bug #80378
    Area-IDE
  • Add friendlier error message on an explicit implementation when the return type is wrong #80376
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • WIP: Normalize the concept of offsets in the parser #80374
    Area-Compilers
  • Remove optional parameter that was always passed the same value #80373
    Area-Compilers
  • Simplify parser diagnostic location calculation #80372
    Area-Compilers
  • WIP: Not for review. #80370
    Area-Compilers
  • Extensions: fix CallerArgumentExpression handling #80367
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything

Merged

  • Fix handling edits in types nested in reloadable types #80360
    Area-Interactive, VSCode, Next
  • Minor cleanup in 'use collection initializer'. #80369
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Publish Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Workspaces.Test.Utilities package to be shared with other repositories #80377
    Area-Infrastructure, VSCode, Next
  • Fix CSharpReplIdeFeatures failing integration tests #80363
    Area-IDE, Next
  • Update Fix-all for "var or explicit-type" to only fix the subset of matches that violated the same rule as the original. #80349
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Remove CS1998 warning entirely and remove dependent C# code fix providers #80144
    Area-Compilers, VSCode, Feature - Runtime Async, Next
  • Unskip tests that are working again #80365
    Area-IDE, Next
  • Add unit tests #80364
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Extensions: fix GetDocumentationCommentXml with netmodule #80297
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything, Next
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #80368
    Area-Infrastructure, Next
  • Backport publish data to 16.11 #80335

Updated

  • Properly populate ExportedType metadata table for forwarded extension blocks. #80361
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything
  • Don't report CLS compliance warnings for attributes on inacessible types #68527
    Area-Compilers, untriaged, Backlog
  • Add code formatting fixer to ProposalAdjuster #80340
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Add support for inverting #if directives. #80338
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Block spreads in exception filters #80337
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Collection Expressions
  • Move package publishing out of Roslyn official build #80009
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Allow dotnet-watch to use MSBuildProjectLoader without launching out-of-process build hosts #80359
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Handled negative span start in SyntaxTreeDiagnosticEnumerator. #79936
    Area-Compilers, Community
